title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Assalam Alaikum, My son's Nikkah has been fixed, and to avoid unwanted expenses we would like to do the Valima soon after the Nikkah. My relative adviced to do the Valima 15 minutes after the Nikkah during this period Bride and Groom should meet together. 1. Please advice is there any time duration limit between Nikkah and Valima? 2. If so what are the formalities to be completed? Your immediate response shall be highly appreciated in this regard. Wassalam. 3666 views Q. Nikah 1937 views Q. A dad had sex with his step daughter. What is Shariah ruling about it? Is his nikah with his wife still valid 9426 views Q. I am Sunni, Muslim, Pathan, male, 37 yrs Old. I got married with a sunni muslim pathan girl in the year 1998, as per the muslim customs and traditions. Just after 10 days of marriage, my wife insisting me for a separate living accommodation. But i denied and explained all my posibilites not able to be separation from my existing family. She pressurising me to give her divorce, asking for money for damage etc. When i refused her she got angry with me and left her matrimonial home. After few days i alongwith all my family members booked against a f.i.r under criminal offence of dowry prohibition and dowery demand. The trial of the application is still pending in the district(english) court of matropolitian magistrate. She had also moved an application for her maintenance in the similar court, and one suit for damage for rupees four lackhs in a district court. Since 1998 she is living with her parental home. I came to know that she got married with another man without getting divorce from me, at another city in barriely. In this contest i humbly request you to kindly arrange to issue a fatwa in this regard that her second marriage is null and void as per shariat law and it is also a criminal offence under muslim marriage act 1939 under section 494 that is bia-gami law. Kindly also issue fatwa allowing me to get second married. 3193 views Q. Regarding Mahr 2072 views Q. Nikah by authorization 1899 views Q. mahram 8713 views Q. Nikah 3181 views Q. Nikkah for my brother 3359 views Q. Ghusul 3996 views Q. I am getting married next month on 4 Feb 2012, my intention is to follow the Sunnah way but my mother-in-law during the day of nikah wants to invite all the known people 2274 views Q. Regarding validity for marriage 2470 views Q. I want to marry a girl(Fathima) who is handicapped. She doesn't have both of her legs. We both wants to marry each other. But my parents are strongly against this decision. My parents think that we will not be able to deliver children if we marry. My parents also think that they may need to put extra hard work to take care of Fathima after marriage. So, they are totally against our decision. But myself and Fathima have taken up the decision to marry. We have also decided that parent's permission is essential for our marriage. Since i am the only one taking care of my parents, i cannot afford to leave my parents. My parents and Fathima, both are inevitable for my life. InshAllah please advice how to convince my parents in islamic view point. What should i do now? 3982 views Q. Paying mahr 3760 views Q. answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 1971 Country: India Title: Is it jayaz for man to meet his wife before marriage or a man and woman can meet each other before marriage and select each other only after seeing each other? Question: Is it jayaz for man to meet his wife before marriage or a man and woman can meet each other before marriage and select each other only after seeing each other? Answer ID: 1971 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 695/698=D) A man and woman, before nikah , are like strangers; they can not see and meet each other. It is not right to see the girl you want to marry by appointing a meeting; it is allowable only if you see her by chance. It is better to get a proposed girl seen by ones relative women. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
